checks: A real printed crown placement before any finale collection leaves the table palette and signal untouched
The existing local crown landing impact still plays
An actual four-card collection sets the final table to scarlet and counts exactly four physical cards
Another crown placement cannot change the collection palette, backdrop or cumulative glitch
An opponent two-card collection adds two rather than one event or four assumed cards
Another player collecting a duplicate faction continues the total
Hakurei contributes cards and its red table colour while preserving the current realm background
Repeated collections reach a bounded glitch maximum with only five signal layers
Visual escalation changes no cards, board size, score or AI state and has no per-frame JavaScript loop
The counter continues past the visual cap without growing effect strength or DOM
Invalid, zero and unsupported collection reports cannot corrupt the signal
A first Hakurei collection starts a fresh signal without requiring a background scene
The first later scenery transition preserves an earlier Hakurei count
Signal strength keeps increasing after board expansion reaches its maximum
A partially resolved collection counts only the one collected card and does not replace the complete-realm colour
Phone uses all eleven explicit faction colours and distinct bounded realm elements
Desktop uses all eleven explicit faction colours and distinct bounded realm elements
Sage has six actual watching eyes and two articulated two-leaf doors on desktop
Phone retains four large eyes and both doors
Eientei adds paper fading and cracks above the whole game and marks weathered panels
The next realm removes Eientei weathered panel styling
Sunflower uses heat sheets around a sun rather than falling flowers
Reduced motion stops eyes, doors, snow, heat, erosion and glitch movement while preserving static identities
Retry/exit clears colours, signal, weathering, layers and pending frames; late callbacks cannot revive them
A new match starts at zero and rejects an abandoned match’s scheduled realm
Fast AI evaluation does not build or count visual effects
Ordinary-mode crown backgrounds and their colours still work
Ordinary collections retain scenery without finale-only glitch or colour replacement
A late crown texture callback cannot overwrite the independent finale collection palette
Scarlet fog has a full-screen foreground wash and unmasked moving banks, including the centre
Hell uses the Higan asset shared by Eiki and Kutaka
Sunflower scenery contains a blazing white-gold sun and no flower imagery
All ten realms have independent motion families instead of universal falling particles
Snow layers use unrotated overscan and translations instead of rotating finite texture rectangles
Analytical bounds keep every moving snow layer covering narrow phones, landscape phones and wide desktops throughout its cycle
Snow loops by exact tile periods and phone snowfall retains its storm speed
The effect layers consume no game RNG, timers, canvas snapshots or pointer events
scope: Production crown/claim events, actual 2/4-card collections across players, repeats, cumulative bounded signal, faction colour isolation, all realm structures, analytical snow coverage and seamless tile periods, reduced motion, cleanup and ordinary-mode regression. Controlled DOM and CSS contracts, not browser pixels or device FPS.
